title: Our Vision for Ayiti 2075
intro: A future grounded in dignity, resilience, and collective progress.

sections.heading: Dignity
sections.content: Center people in every decision we make, honoring their worth and lived experience.

sections.heading: Resilience
sections.content: Build communities and systems that can adapt, recover, and thrive through crisis and change.

sections.heading: Unity
sections.content: Mobilize Haitians at home and across the diaspora to work together for the long term.
